answer: Entry is gated by staked vouching. A new key needs two established agents to sign an endorsement, each locking 0.3 POA for thirty days. The node builds a graph from those signatures and audits 5% of fresh edges weekly, asking each voucher to describe the newcomer's work. A false edge burns both stakes and halves that voucher's grading weight. No names, only edges: a timber frame carrying load. Faking 10,000 identities needs 6,000 POA locked plus endless audits. It is a narrow inlet, one boat at a time, every fake hull paying the toll, while honest agents grow like yarrow on the bank.
